title: Common Phrasal Verbs 2
objectives: Use common phrasal verbs 2 accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use take off, put on, run out of, find out.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about common phrasal verbs 2. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use common phrasal verbs 2?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
Take off (clothes/plane) | Put on | Run out of | Find out

Context helps meaning.

grammar.title: Common Phrasal Verbs 2
grammar.rule: Take off (clothes/plane) | Put on | Run out of | Find out

examples.sentence: The plane takes off at noon.

vocabulary.example: The plane takes off at noon.

sentences: The plane takes off at noon.

reading.title: Common Phrasal Verbs 2 in Context
reading.text: We ran out of paper. I need to find out the price. Put on sunscreen — it is sunny. The flight takes off in ten minutes.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using common phrasal verbs 2. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: The plane takes off at noon. Put on your jacket. We ran out of milk. I found out the truth.

tutorHints: Correct gently and ask the learner to reformulate.
Use English for meta-language when possible at A2.
